title: ci: release automation for private deployments - artifact signing, provenance, and release manifests
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: enable end-to-end release automation for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) including reproducible artifact builds, cryptographic signing, provenance attestations, and generated release manifests consumable by on-prem installers and air-gapped environments. This PR adds: 1) artifact build pipeline (container images + helm charts + terraform modules) with deterministic digests; 2) signing step using our KMS-backed signing service and inclusion of signature envelopes; 3) SLSA-style provenance artifacts (build metadata and attestations); 4) release-manifests generator that produces channel manifests (stable/canary) and CSVs for air-gapped installs; 5) Helm chart tweaks to support imagePullSecrets and deterministic values; 6) small terraform module changes to expose module_version and checksum for release manifests. Checklist: Implement build jobs and artifact layout; Add signing and attestation steps; Generate release manifests and upload to releases bucket; Helm lint and chart packaging; Terraform module output for checksum; Add docs stub and release_notes. Related: Linear ENG-4821 for artifact pipeline, ENG-4890 for release manifests. See design notes in PR comment thread and release runbook link: https://internal.redwood/release/runbooks/private-ci.

release_notes: Release automation for Private deployments: deterministic artifact builds, KMS-backed signing, SLSA-style provenance artifacts, and release-manifests generator for stable/canary channels. Adds helm chart packaging improvements (imagePullSecrets) and terraform outputs for release checksums. This enables reproducible air-gapped installs and signed release bundles.
